goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new account, navigate the calendar to the next month, and access the settings menu via the settings button.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) located next to the month title to navigate to July 2026.
Click the settings button (gear icon) located in the left sidebar to open the settings menu.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the sign-up page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view updates to display 'July 2026' after clicking the navigation button.
The settings menu or panel becomes visible, displaying options such as 'Shown time' and 'Order' dropdowns.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or navigation steps.
